note: Node Title Help Text adds per-content-type help text under the node Title field. No settings page (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, no plugins. Its only persistent state is a third-party setting on each node type: node.type.<bundle>.third_party.node_title_help_text.title_help (schema node.type.*.third_party.node_title_help_text). The text is applied as the title widget #description on node add/edit forms only if the title field has no description already, and also inside Inline Entity Form node widgets. Medium/hard cases use namespaced content types (nthht_*) and are grounded in that real third-party setting: introspection reads back which type has help / its text; execution sets the title_help on a node type, verified from live config.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Drupal node_title_help_text module. Where do I enter the help text that shows under the node Title field, and where is that value stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no dedicated settings page. Edit the content type (Structure -> Content types -> Edit), fill 'Title field help text' under the Submission form settings tab. It is stored as a third-party setting: node.type.<bundle>.third_party_settings.node_title_help_text.title_help.

evals.prompt: With node_title_help_text, can I show different title help text for different content types, and does it override help text another module already put on the title field?
evals.expected_output: Yes, the help text is stored per content type (per node type), so each type can have its own. It is applied as the title widget's #description only if the title field has no description already, so it does not override help another module set.

evals.prompt: Where does the text configured by node_title_help_text actually appear for a content editor, and does it work inside Inline Entity Form?
evals.expected_output: It appears as the description under the Title field on that content type's node add/edit form. It also applies inside Inline Entity Form node widgets via hook_inline_entity_form_entity_form_alter().

evals.prompt: On this site there is a content type with machine name 'nthht_known' that has node title help text configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the help text that editors see under the Title field for that content type.
evals.expected_output: The title help text for nthht_known is 'Enter the official product name, e.g. Widget Pro 3000.' (node.type.nthht_known third_party_settings.node_title_help_text.title_help).

evals.prompt: This site has two content types, nthht_on and nthht_off. Exactly one of them has node title help text configured via node_title_help_text. Inspect the live configuration and state which content type has title help text set.
evals.expected_output: nthht_on has title help set (node.type.nthht_on third_party_settings.node_title_help_text.title_help = 'Give this landing page a campaign-specific title.'), while nthht_off has no such setting.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a content type with machine name 'nthht_task'. Using the node_title_help_text module, configure it so the Title field on that content type's add/edit form shows the help text: Enter a short, descriptive title of at most 60 characters. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: node.type.nthht_task third_party_settings.node_title_help_text.title_help is set exactly to 'Enter a short, descriptive title of at most 60 characters.' (e.g. via NodeType::setThirdPartySetting or drush config:set, or the content type edit form).

evals.prompt: On my website I have a content type called 'nthht_recipe'. When my editors create one, I want a little hint to appear under the big title box telling them what to type there. Please make that hint show up.
evals.expected_output: node.type.nthht_recipe third_party_settings.node_title_help_text.title_help is set to any non-empty guidance text, using the node_title_help_text module (content type edit form 'Title field help text', or NodeType::setThirdPartySetting / drush config:set).
